profile.name: HP 4395A 网络/频谱/阻抗分析仪
profile.description: HP 4395A 是一款台式射频测试仪器，可进行网络分析、频谱分析以及阻抗测量。它常用于电子与射频实验中测量器件或电路的传输/反射特性、扫频响应、源功率相关响应以及阻抗参数。
profile.description_en: The HP 4395A is a benchtop RF test instrument for network analysis, spectrum analysis, and impedance measurement. It is commonly used in electronics and RF labs to measure transmission and reflection characteristics, swept-frequency response, source-power-dependent behavior, and impedance-related parameters of devices and circuits.
